note: Prompt-level cases for the newui agent skill. Each case is a realistic request plus the one thing a correct answer must do and the repo file that grounds it. See README.md for how they are run and scored.

cases.prompt: Add an activity feed panel to the project page. Each row shows an avatar, a line saying who did what, and a muted relative timestamp on the right, separated by hairlines.
cases.check: Every colour is a semantic token — `bg-surface-*`, `text-ink-*`, `border-outline-*` (or a bare `border`/`divide-y`) — with no `bg-white`, `bg-gray-*`/`slate-*`/`zinc-*`, no `text-gray-*`/`black`/`white`, and no hard-coded hex/rgb/hsl.

cases.prompt: Add a light/dark toggle to the app header. It should remember the user's choice and follow the OS when they pick 'system'.
cases.check: Light/dark is driven by `createColorScheme` (the `colorScheme` axis) which flips `data-theme` and persists the choice; it is not expressed as a `theme` prop, and `theme` is never used to mean light/dark.

cases.prompt: Add a dialog to the projects page that asks for a new project name and creates it.
cases.check: The Dialog's visibility is `open` + `onOpenChange` bound to a signal (or `defaultOpen` for uncontrolled use); there is no `v-model`, `modelValue` or `isOpen` prop.

cases.prompt: Add a 'Notify me by email' toggle to the notification settings.
cases.check: The Switch uses `checked` + `onCheckedChange` to control, or `defaultChecked` uncontrolled — the component does not hold its own signal and there is no `v-model`/`modelValue`.

cases.prompt: Build a filter popover for the task list. It doesn't need to be driven from outside the component.
cases.check: Uncontrolled use is expressed with the `default*` prop (`defaultOpen` / `defaultValue` / `defaultChecked`), not by omitting the prop and reaching into the machine; controlled use still pairs `value` with `onValueChange`.

cases.prompt: Add a 'Title' field to the create-project form. It's required.
cases.check: The field's label comes from the `label` prop (drawn by `Field`), not from a `placeholder` or a hand-written `<label>`; `required` is passed as a prop, not spelled with a manual asterisk.

cases.prompt: The Title field must show 'Title is required' when it's submitted empty, and the message must be announced to screen readers.
cases.check: The message is passed through the `error` prop, which renders `role="alert"` and links `aria-errormessage`/`aria-describedby` via `Field` — not a hand-styled error `<div>` with no ARIA wiring.

cases.prompt: Add an icon-only 'close' button to the panel header.
cases.check: The icon-only button supplies an accessible name (`aria-label`), recognising that P5's labelling contract does not apply to buttons; it does not pass `label` as if the Button were an input.

cases.prompt: Add an assignee picker with a few hundred people. The user should be able to type to narrow the list before picking one.
cases.check: This is a `Combobox` (searchable single select: `options`, `value: string | null`, `onValueChange`), not a `Select` (a fixed option list) and not a `multiple` flag.

cases.prompt: Add a tags field where a task can carry several labels, each removable.
cases.check: This is `MultiSelect` — its own component with `value: string[]` and `onValueChange`, not `Combobox` with a `multiple` flag (P8).

cases.prompt: Add an actions menu to each ticket row with Edit, Duplicate and Delete.
cases.check: The simple action list is the options-based `Dropdown` (`options` + `onSelect` + trigger `children`); `danger` marks the destructive option. It is not a hand-built menu.

cases.prompt: Build a menu whose trigger is a custom avatar-and-name button and whose rows contain a checkbox and a shortcut hint.
cases.check: A trigger or rows beyond `label`/`icon`/`danger` use the compound `Menu.Root`/`Menu.Trigger`/`Menu.Content`/`Menu.Item`, not `Dropdown` (which is options-only).

cases.prompt: Let people right-click a file row to get Rename, Download and Delete.
cases.check: The right-click menu is `ContextMenu` (Zag's `menu` machine via its `contextTrigger`), not `Menu`/`Dropdown` opened from a button.

cases.prompt: Add a priority picker with Low / Medium / High, where only one can be chosen.
cases.check: The single-choice group is `RadioGroup` imported from `@newui/molecules`.

cases.prompt: Add a due-date field to the task form. Only a date, no time, and it can be cleared.
cases.check: `FormControl type="date"` renders `DatePicker` with `value: string | null` (`YYYY-MM-DD`) plus `onValueChange`; it is not a native `<input type="date">` treated as a text type.

cases.prompt: Add a 'Done' checkbox to the task form. The state is owned by the form's signal.
cases.check: `FormControl type="checkbox"` uses `checked` + `onCheckedChange` (or `defaultChecked`); it does not pass `description`/`error`/`required`, which the resolved control does not support.

cases.prompt: Add a Status field to the form, rendered from a field definition, with options To do / Doing / Done.
cases.check: `FormControl type="select"` passes `options` with `value: string[]` and `onValueChange` (select's own surface), not a scalar `string` value.

cases.prompt: Add a password field to the login form with a show/hide reveal control.
cases.check: `FormControl type="password"` is a plain masked `TextInput`; the reveal toggle is the separate `Password` component, not a hand-rolled toggle.

cases.prompt: Style the highlighted option in a Combobox differently from the rest, and the open state of its trigger.
cases.check: Customisation targets `data-slot` / `data-state` (and Zag's `data-highlighted` / `data-disabled`) attributes in CSS, not an `itemClass`/`contentClass`/`triggerClass` prop.

cases.prompt: Make this dialog wider than the default.
cases.check: Width is set with a utility on the root `class` (merged last through `cn()`), not via a `contentClass`/`contentStyle` or other class-injection prop.

cases.prompt: Import the components for a new tickets screen.
cases.check: Atoms and molecules are imported from their respective root barrels (`@newui/atoms` and `@newui/molecules`); `List` is exported from the `@newui/molecules` root, not a component subpath or a separate package.

cases.prompt: Wire the library stylesheet into the app's CSS entry.
cases.check: The stylesheet is `@newui/tailwind/style.css`; visual component packages do not export a duplicate `./style.css` subpath.

cases.prompt: Add a revenue chart to the dashboard.
cases.check: The chart comes from the `@newui/charts` workspace package (cost isolation), not a subpath of an atomic package and not a hand-rolled SVG.

cases.prompt: Add a new Zag-backed toggle component to the library.
cases.check: The machine is wired with `createZagApi(machine, connect, props)` from `lib/zag` (the connected API is a memo, props an accessor); the component never calls `useMachine` directly.

cases.prompt: Add a compound `Chip.Root` / `Chip.Item` family backed by a Zag machine.
cases.check: The family's shared API uses `createZagContext(name)` — a provider plus a `useApi` hook that throws a named 'must be used within <Name.Root>' error — instead of a bespoke context.

cases.prompt: Deleting a workspace is permanent, so confirm it before deleting.
cases.check: The confirmation is the imperative `dialog.danger(...)` (awaited, resolving `true`/`false`), with `<DialogHost />` mounted once near the app root — not a hand-mounted `<Dialog>` plus a boolean signal.
